idFormat: DOMAIN.TYPE.NAME[.VARIANT], UPPER_SNAKE segments, dot separated. IDs never change once published.

rarities.N: Phàm: plain dull bronze/iron, no glow, no ornament, thin border.
rarities.R: Linh: jade green-blue, simple clean lines, faint soft glow.
rarities.SR: Huyền: violet and silver, small cloud/lotus ornaments, medium glow.
rarities.SSR: Thiên: polished gold, engraved dragon/phoenix scrollwork, strong warm glow, corner jewels.
rarities.UR: Tiên: celestial multi-hue (gold, white, aurora cyan-magenta), wings/halo ornaments, floating light particles, intense radiance. Must look clearly grander than SSR, not just brighter.

sheets.desc: Frames only, centre empty/transparent-looking flat fill. Columns are rarities N,R,SR,SSR,UR, in that order. Rows: item slot frame (square), card frame (portrait 2:3), name plate (wide banner).
Columns are rarities N,R,SR,SSR,UR. Row 1: summon glow burst (radial). Row 2: card shine sweep overlay. Glow colour and intensity follow the rarity table; N is nearly none.
No text on buttons. Columns are states: normal, hover, pressed, disabled. Rows: primary (gold), secondary (jade), danger (crimson), tab.
Empty containers, no text, nothing inside. Left to right, top to bottom as listed.
Currency and material icons, one object per cell, centred, no text.
Element emblems, same style and size, distinct silhouettes.
Lobby menu icons, one per cell. The last cell is left empty.
